title: WEScreens
description: Meet WEScreens — a mod that lets you build functional menus right inside the game, without knowing how to code.
body:
# WEScreens

Create fully customizable in-game GUI screens for Minecraft Forge - without writing Java code.

**WEScreens** is a visual GUI editor that lets you design interfaces directly inside Minecraft. Create menus, dialogs, shops, quest windows, server information screens, and much more using an intuitive drag-and-drop editor. Save your screens to the world and open them instantly with commands.

## ⚠️ Beta Status

WEScreens is currently in **Beta stage**.

This means the mod is still under active development and may contain bugs, unfinished features, or unexpected behavior.

Please keep in mind:

* Some features may change or be reworked in future updates
* Bugs or crashes may occur in certain cases
* World data compatibility may not be guaranteed between versions
* Performance and stability improvements are ongoing

Feedback and bug reports are appreciated and help improve the mod.


## ✨ Features

* 🎨 Visual in-game GUI editor
* 🖱️ Drag & drop interface editing
* 📏 Move and resize elements freely
* 🔒 Lock elements to prevent accidental movement
* 📑 Multi-tab interfaces
* 📂 Nested containers with independent tabs
* 📝 Rich text with colors, alignment, and custom scaling
* 🖼️ Display any Minecraft texture
* ⚡ Execute commands with buttons
* 📦 Screens are automatically saved in world data
* 👥 Open screens for specific players using commands
* 🔄 Edit existing screens at any time

## 🧩 Available Components

* Text
* Images
* Close Buttons
* Command Buttons
* Tab Buttons
* Tab Containers
* Containers

## 🛠️ Commands

WEScreens provides two simple commands for creating and managing your custom interfaces.

* `/createscreen <name>`
  Creates a new screen and opens it in the visual editor.

* `/screen <name> <action> [new_name]`
  Manage an existing screen.

  **Available actions:**

  * `open` — Open the screen.
  * `edit` — Open the screen in the editor.
  * `rename` — Rename the screen (requires `new_name`).
  * `delete` — Delete the screen permanently.

**Example:**

```text
/screen MainMenu rename LobbyMenu
```


## 🔥 Dynamic Placeholders

Display real-time information inside your interfaces.

Examples:

* `%playername%`
* `%displayname%`
* `%health%`
* `%food%`
* `%xp%`
* `%level%`
* `%coords%`
* `%biome%`
* `%dimension%`
* `%time%`
* `%totalplayers%`

...and many more.

## 📚 Perfect For

* Rules screens
* Quest systems
* Tutorials
* Shops
* Admin panels
* Command hubs
* Factions & clans

## 🚀 Why WEScreens?

Unlike traditional GUI mods, WEScreens doesn't require creating a new GUI in code every time you need a menu.

Design, edit, and update interfaces directly in-game with a powerful visual editor, making iteration fast and simple while supporting everything from basic menus to complex multi-tab layouts.

Whether you're creating a modpack or adventure map, WEScreens provides a flexible and efficient way to build beautiful Minecraft interfaces.
